test_title: PYST 02: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 956 521 251 156 335 (Right)

(Example: 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)

(NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)

What will be the resultant if the second digit of the highest number is added to the first digit of the lowest number?
solution:
Given: (Left) 956 521 251 156 335 (Right)

The second digit of the highest number is: 5 (956)

And, 

The first digit of the lowest number is: 1 (156)

So, the addition of the second digit of the highest number and the first digit of the lowest number is:

→ 5 + 1 = 6.

The correct answer is "Option 1".
